mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT l.sido FROM shooting_location l WHERE l.active_yn = 'Y' AND l.sido IS NOT NULL AND l.sido != ''
AND (
( l.place_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR l.sido LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR l.sigungu LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR l.lot_address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR l.road_address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR l.search_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM shooting_location_history kh WHERE kh.location_id = l.location_id AND ( kh.movie_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR kh.scene_description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ) )
)
ORDER BY l.sido
SELECT FROM shooting_location l WHERE l.location_id = #{locationId} AND l.active_yn = 'Y'

SELECT h.history_id AS historyId, h.location_id AS locationId, h.source_event_id AS sourceEventId, h.movie_code AS movieCode, h.movie_title AS movieTitle, h.production_year AS productionYear, h.scene_description AS sceneDescription, h.characters, h.source_name AS sourceName, h.source_url AS sourceUrl FROM shooting_location_history h WHERE h.location_id = #{locationId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN h.scene_description LIKE '%폐업%' OR h.scene_description LIKE '%영업 종료%' OR h.scene_description LIKE '%영업종료%' OR h.scene_description LIKE '%철거%' OR h.scene_description LIKE '%멸실%' OR h.scene_description LIKE '%현재 없음%' OR h.scene_description LIKE '%공터%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN h.scene_description IS NOT NULL AND h.scene_description != '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, h.production_year DESC, h.history_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO location_search_session ( user_id, team_id, prompt, context_type, parsed_conditions_json, candidate_count, recommendation_count, status, failure_reason, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{teamId}, #{prompt}, #{contextType}, #{parsedConditionsJson}, #{candidateCount}, #{recommendationCount}, #{status}, #{failureReason}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO location_recommendation_result ( session_id, location_id, rank_no, score, ai_summary, match_reason, usage_idea, recommendation_basis, check_points_json, model_name, fallback_yn, created_at ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{locationId}, #{rankNo}, #{score}, #{aiSummary}, #{matchReason}, #{usageIdea}, #{recommendationBasis}, #{checkPointsJson}, #{modelName}, #{fallbackYn}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT s.session_id AS sessionId, s.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS userNickname, s.team_id AS teamId, t.name AS teamName, s.prompt, s.context_type AS contextType, s.parsed_conditions_json AS parsedConditionsJson, s.candidate_count AS candidateCount, s.recommendation_count AS recommendationCount, s.status, s.failure_reason AS failureReason, s.created_at AS createdAt FROM location_search_session s JOIN user_account u ON u.user_id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN team t ON t.team_id = s.team_id WHERE s.session_id = #{sessionId}

SELECT r.recommendation_id AS recommendationId, r.session_id AS sessionId, r.location_id AS locationId, r.rank_no AS rankNo, r.score, r.ai_summary AS aiSummary, r.match_reason AS matchReason, r.usage_idea AS usageIdea, r.recommendation_basis AS recommendationBasis, r.check_points_json AS checkPointsJson, r.model_name AS modelName, r.fallback_yn AS fallbackYn, r.created_at AS createdAt, l.place_name AS placeName, l.sido, l.sigungu, l.lot_address AS lotAddress, l.road_address AS roadAddress, l.latitude, l.longitude, l.quality_flags_json AS qualityFlagsJson FROM location_recommendation_result r JOIN shooting_location l ON l.location_id = r.location_id WHERE r.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY r.rank_no, r.recommendation_id

SELECT r.recommendation_id AS recommendationId, r.session_id AS sessionId, r.location_id AS locationId, r.rank_no AS rankNo, r.score, r.fallback_yn AS fallbackYn, s.user_id AS userId, s.team_id AS teamId FROM location_recommendation_result r JOIN location_search_session s ON s.session_id = r.session_id WHERE r.recommendation_id = #{recommendationId}

SELECT FROM saved_location_candidate c JOIN user_account saver ON saver.user_id = c.user_id JOIN shooting_location l ON l.location_id = c.location_id LEFT JOIN location_search_session s ON s.session_id = c.session_id LEFT JOIN location_recommendation_result r ON r.recommendation_id = c.recommendation_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.location_id = #{locationId} AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
AND c.team_id = #{teamId}
AND c.team_id IS NULL
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.candidate_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO saved_location_candidate ( user_id, team_id, location_id, session_id, recommendation_id, title, memo, status, source_type, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{teamId}, #{locationId}, #{sessionId}, #{recommendationId}, #{title}, #{memo}, #{status}, #{sourceType}, NOW() )
